pathway.title: Enel EFI · historical sustainability-linked coupon test
pathway.question: What cash coupon could the documented ratchet add, and which conditions remain unproven?

runs.text: View: the documented 25bp increase changes the annual coupon equivalent on full original principal from EUR0m to EUR2.5m if effective. A known 0% cash coupon does not mean free financing. June's KPI is below the later target, but is not a target-date failure or evidence that the step actually occurred. Verification, publication, notification and timing remain separate conditions.

A real coupon incentive can consume cash when effective: on the stipulated original principal, one fully stepped year adds EUR2.5m. It is not net hedged group cost, a market-spread forecast or an established refinancing shortfall. The initial coupon's zero is meaningful, but the issue discount and positive reported yield prevent a claim of costless financing.

The contrary case is timely satisfaction of the complete condition, leaving the initial coupon unchanged. No target-date certificate or notification outcome has been admitted. Monitor the final defined KPI and process evidence rather than treating June's shortfall as a realised miss. The programme distinguishes the capacity-linked consequence from automatic default/repurchase; no review of other possible default provisions or recovery protection is claimed.
